name: anim_koya_riseB
subject: a slim, lean-muscled dog man made of glossy brown paint with broad diagonal cream bands and a bushy tail
desc: The hunched paint mound slowly and stickily gets up into a melted humanoid: the back straightens, the arms peel away from the body and droop down, thick strands of paint stretch and sag between the body and the puddle, the head lifts out of the goo and tilts back toward the sky with the mouth gaping open, thick sticky strings stretching between the jaws. No eyes. Slow, heavy, sticky, viscous, gooey.
